cover.coreProposition: OAuth refresh should be modeled as a split-commit workflow whenever remote credential issuance and local durable persistence are separate operations; persistence failure after remote success is a distinct partial-success state that must remain visible for reconciliation.
cover.visualMetaphor: A newly minted credential token crossing a boundary while its durable vault slot remains visibly open
cover.semanticObject: One fresh token suspended between a remote issuer and an uncommitted local vault
cover.compositionIntent: Serious landscape editorial cover with a single high-contrast token, split depth planes and restrained security materials
